## Checks

- [ ] Built and tested locally (`scripts\build.cmd x64-release`, and `x64-debug` for C++ changes);
      tests that change the PC (`system`, the writing commands) were not run on a PC in use
      (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)).
- [ ] C++ formatted with clang-format 23.x.
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed (`docs/CLI.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md`).
- [ ] No personal data: no names, e-mail addresses, profile paths, PC names or private PDFs in the
      code, tests, screenshots or commit messages.
